Pick a fruit

❯ 1. Apple
     A crisp, round fruit with white flesh and thin skin. Apples keep well and are eaten fresh,
     baked, or pressed into juice. They come in many varieties, from tart green ones to sweet red
     ones.
  2. Pear
     A soft, bell-shaped fruit with grainy, juicy flesh and a mild sweetness. Pears ripen best off
     the tree and are often eaten fresh or poached. They bruise easily, so handle them with care.
